tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List connected fabrication providers, supported files and connection status.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Upload a part and obtain live manufacturing estimates. Files are sent to eligible providers and retained privately for seven days. Only FDM STL in millimeters is currently live. Does not order or pay.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Retrieve a saved quote with its private quote access token.

tools.name: request_order_review
tools.description: Request human review of a saved quote. Requires quoting access token and contact email. Never places a provider order or takes payment. Unavailable until review notifications are connected.
